keys.effect: Internal render resolution percentage relative to target resolution.
keys.notes: At 0, resolution scaling may use system fallback or dynamic defaults. Setting to 100 ensures full native pixel rendering.

keys.effect: Draw distance and LOD transition distance for world objects and geometry.
Anti-aliasing quality and temporal reconstruction (TSR / TAA).
Virtual Shadow Maps (VSM) resolution, shadow cascades, and contact shadows.
keys.notes: Quality 4 enables highest precision VSM. Quality 2/3 gives optimal frame stability on high-end hardware.

keys.effect: Lumen Global Illumination quality, probe density, and update frequency.
keys.notes: Controls UE5 Lumen GI. Quality 4 enables epic lighting detail.

keys.effect: Lumen Reflection quality and screen-space reflection resolution.
Depth of field, bloom, motion blur intensity, and tonemapping fidelity.
Texture streaming pool allocation and mipmap resolution.
keys.notes: Bandwidth-bound. On 12GB+ GPUs (like RTX 4070 SUPER), set to 4 for maximum detail.

keys.effect: VFX particle density, simulation fidelity, and volumetric fog quality.
Foliage density, culling distance, and grass mesh LODs.
Subsurface scattering, hair rendering, and material shader complexity.
Terrain tessellation and landscape heightmap LOD resolution.
Forces NVIDIA DLSS upscaling plugin active at engine boot.
Disables AMD FSR override to prevent resetting from DLSS.

engine_overrides.behaviour: The game caches graphics options in borSaveDataLocalConfig.sav and resets to FSR / 1080p if Engine.ini lacks explicit system settings overrides.
engine_overrides.action: Use Engine.ini with [SystemSettings] r.NGX.DLSS.Enable=1 and r.FidelityFX.FSR2.Enabled=0 to lock NVIDIA DLSS.
